sentences.text: En route at or near about Sirhol Border, one Tavera tourist vehicle bearing Registration No. HR55GT3522 (hereinafter referred as offending vehicle) which was being driven in a rash and negligent manner by respondent no. 1 hit the petitioner's two wheeler from behind.

In the present case, as per the Disability Certificate issued by DDU Hospital, New Delhi, the petitioner / injured - Anila Rajeev is a case of Left United Inter Trochanteric Fracture has a Permanent Physical Disability of 17% in relation to Left Lower Limb.

Keeping in view the job of the petitioner, I am of the opinion that permanent disability of 17% in relation to permanent physical disability in relation to Left Lower Limb shall effect 8.5.% upon her working capacity.
The Court has already given its opinion that salary of Rs. 8510/ p.m is taken as criteria for calculating the loss of income to the petitioner/injured.
